title: Unsupported actions/cache runtime
summary: This release uses a retired JavaScript runtime or cache service. Version 5 moved the action to Node.js 24.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve cache keys, restore-key ordering, paths, and cache-hit dependent control flow.

steps.title: Upgrade the cache action
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/cache@v5 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review cache behavior
steps.instructions: Verify cache paths, keys, restore keys, and cache-hit output consumers against the target release.
